column1: # core/data/talk/corpus/parse_en.tsv - the English parser corpus (owner: TK, T3;
# docs/TALK.md "The parser"; design 3.2). Measured by core/tests/test_talk_parse.c
# (bars: act 90%, topic 85%, addressee 95%); talkc --check (TK8) checks the format.
#   @room NAME, NAME, ...            the residents in the room (slot order; the ring is slot 0)
# ACT     the TA_* name (talk.h) of what the line mainly does; ACT2 the second act if any
# TOPIC   the concept key the line is about, or - (no talkable concept)
# TARGET  who it is said to: a NAME of the room, all (everyone), or - (the ring: nobody named)
# Written to the game's register (docs/design/story/SCRIPT_STYLE.md), typed the way
# people type: about one line in six has a misspelling, a shortcut or leet.
# Safety lines are not here: corpus/safety_en.tsv and adversarial_en.tsv (T4).
